status_note: A summary written for ELI Legal, in its own words. It is not the text of the instrument and has not been validated by a qualified lawyer. Check the official text before relying on any statement in it. Section numbers are given as a guide; confirm them against the Act.
title: Mediation Act 2017 (Ireland)
description: Confidentiality of mediation and the conduct of mediators in Ireland.

requirements.title: Confidentiality of mediation communications
requirements.text: Communications and records made in the course of a mediation are confidential and are not disclosed in proceedings, subject to the exceptions in the Act.

requirements.reference: the Act's provisions on the mediator's conduct
requirements.title: Impartial conduct
requirements.text: The mediator acts impartially and does not decide for the parties.
requirements.instruction: Do not propose terms of settlement or say what either party should accept.
